prompt: Produce a square base-colour game texture inspired faithfully by this Caledonia Iron Works facade reference: rough-faced rectangular warm grey stone blocks visible in the horizontal bands and lower plinth. Reconstruct a patch of that stone masonry with two to four rows of rectangular stones, broad irregular fractured faces, narrow pale mortar joints. Do not use smooth rendered panels. Flat frontal orthographic surface fills whole image. Even neutral diffuse colour, no cast shadows, directional highlights, windows, text, borders, trim, vegetation or objects. Seamless repeatable edges requested. Authored reconstruction for prototyping, not measured albedo. Preserve the material's natural surface identity.
